networks.name: pizza_restaurant_website_assistant
networks.description: Triages customer requests for a pizza restaurant website, gathers minimal clarifying details, and delegates to the appropriate specialist for menu browsing, ordering/checkout, or delivery tracking, then summarizes results and guides next steps.
sample_queries: What gluten-free pizza options do you have, and which ones can be made vegan?
I want a large pepperoni pizza for delivery to 123 Main St—add cheesy bread and apply code FAMILY20, then show me the order total before I pay.
My order #48219 says “out for delivery” for 45 minutes—what’s the latest ETA and what should I check if it was marked delivered but I don’t have it?
What deals are running today, and can you recommend a combo for two people under $25 that includes a drink?

peer_policy.note: Public agent sites are reachable like web pages; credentials and capabilities do not transfer.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
